welcome.text: Welcome to Tweezer Rescue! Pinch, lift, and carry your little friends home.

how.text: Press and hold to squeeze. Carry them home, and let go!

intro-ladybugs.text: Oh no! The ladybugs slipped off their flowers. Let's carry them home with your tweezers!

prompt-pink.text: This ladybug wants the pink flower.

prompt-white.text: This one loves the white flower.

prompt-purple.text: Carry this ladybug to the purple flower.

intro-bees.text: The sleepy bees tumbled out of their honeycomb! Let's tuck them back in, one by one.

count-6.text: Six bees! The honeycomb is full!

intro-fish.text: Splash! The goldfish jumped out of the pond. Match each fish to its pool!

prompt-big.text: This is a big fish. Find the big pool!

prompt-medium.text: A medium fish, right in the middle.

prompt-little.text: A tiny little fish! Where's the little pool?

intro-pompoms.text: Pom-pom time! Sort the fuzzy pom-poms into their matching nests.

nudge-miss.text: Almost! Carry it a little further.

nudge-wrong.text: Oops! Gently now. Let's try another spot.

nudge-idle.text: Touch a little friend to pick them up.

celebrate.text: Rescue complete! You saved them all!
